title: Very nice scent that lasts a long time.
text: Very nice scent that lasts a long time.. These are packed in a plastic then put inside the box. The smell is very nice and I was surprised they werent " perfumy".. They have a nice natural earthy scent. When I first lit them up, it burned a black smoke but I blew it out right away and the smoke while burning was white. It does not give off a lot of smoke ( a plus)... But the scent stays and has a long burn time. Very good product and I would buy other scents from this company.

product_metadata.title: Shubhkart Musk Incense Sticks/Agarbatti - (Pack of 6 Tubes Inside The Box) 120 Sticks (Musk Incense)
